title: 第三章 仙侠世界一样能推理
content_zh:
这个问题，没人能回答。
李玉春道：“妖物劫走税银的原因是什么？”
陈府尹略一沉思：“妖类做事从不问心，为所欲为，追究原因，不过是自寻烦恼。”
黄裙少女却有不同意见：“人肉不是更好吃.....唔，你们稍等，我先吃完包子。”
她‘吭哧吭哧’的把两只大肉包吃完，自己的脸也变成了小笼包，努力咽下，喝一口茶，这才继续刚才的话题，可以畅所欲言人肉的事儿：
“妖类做事无所顾忌，银子在它们眼里未必有活生生的人诱人。哪怕想要银子，偷窃或抢劫都比直接劫走税银要稳妥。”
在大奉京都，当街劫走税银，风险太大了。
陈府尹点头：“言之有理，不排除是受人指使。”
李玉春眯了眯眼：“那么谁会指使妖类窃取税银呢？理由是什么？为什么非得是这一批税银，非得是十五万两。”
“咱们可以这么想，幕后主使需要一笔巨款，但又不能闹出太大动静....准确说，不能肆无忌惮的敛财。”陈府尹心里一动。
“于是就盯上了税银？”黄裙少女抿了抿唇色鲜艳的嘴。
“税银押运路径是随机的，由御刀卫的百户许平志临时决定，而妖物却能提前在河中埋伏....押运队伍中，极有可能有内应。”李玉春说着，看了眼陈府尹：
“去云鹿书院，找儒家高人来问心？”
黄裙少女斜了他一眼：“你是看不起我们司天监的望气术么，我都说了，在场押运税银的士卒，都是毫不知情的。”
思路又卡住了，三人一阵沉默。
空气一下子安静了。
李玉春低头细看卷宗，陈府尹长吁短叹。黄裙少女摆弄着腰间的风水盘，想着日落前得离开京兆府，进宫找长公主蹭顿饭。
皇宫厨子的手艺，当世一流！
相比起他们，名叫采薇的黄裙少女更多的是充当客卿身份，辅助办案。
她无官无职，虽是案件负责人之一，却不需要背太大的责任。

陈府尹眼神微动，试探道：“眼下案件进展缓慢，而时间刻不容缓，实在令人心急如焚。李大人，不如，去请教魏公？”
中年男人斜了他一眼，冷哼：“你们文官有京察，我们打更人亦有。实话说吧，这便是魏公给我的考核。”
陈府尹苦笑道：“这案子破不了，我屁股底下的位置恐怕也保不住了。朝野上下都在看着我们。”
两人沉默中对视，气氛凝重。
......
“如果是妖物作祟，那我就毫无办法了！”许七安脸色发白，感受到了老天爷深深的恶意。
这个世界是有妖怪的，妖族自古存在，与人类相互狩猎，相互吞食。
南疆十万大山里，有一个万妖国，是妖族最大的聚居地。
五百年前，西方诸国在佛门的带领下，向南疆万妖国宣战，前前后后打了一甲子的战争，最后荡平妖国。
史书上将这场战役命名为‘甲子荡妖’。
自那以后，妖族气运受损，渐渐式微。而佛门从此一飞冲天，佛道昌盛。
用许七安后世知识来理解，在这场食物链顶端的争夺战中人类获得了胜利。
如果税银是妖物作为，那么，他只有追回银子才能保住自己，保全许家。
作为一个炼精巅峰的不屈白银，许七安觉得自己没办法翻盘了。
入秋的季节，天气湿冷，许七安沁出了一身的冷汗。
他怕了！
融合了原主记忆，知道自己根本不可能越狱，更知道这个皇权高高在上的社会，人权太薄弱了。
生杀予夺，全在他人一念之间。
以前也幻想过穿回古代抄诗装逼，觉得很爽，现实狠狠打了他一巴掌。
穿越了还要遭社会毒打。

“不，这只是猜测，这只是京兆府衙门的猜测，我不能被他们的猜测影响，我自己来，自己来分析.....还能抢救，还能抢救....”
强烈的求生欲让他迅速冷静下来，逻辑重新变的严谨、清晰。
“妖物为什么要窃取税银，人肉不香吗.....就算缺银子也没必要盯着税银.....听书上说妖族的妖女个个千娇百媚，身段玲珑.....不知道有没有猫娘狗娘....”
“啪！”许七安给了自己一巴掌，“重新推理！”
推理最重要的是做减法，把线索一条条的罗列出来，进行梳理。
否则就是毛线团，只会越想越乱。
税银案两个最明显的线索：
一：妖风！
二：税银坠河后爆炸！
除了武夫之外，各大修炼体系都拥有刮妖风的能力，因此，‘线索一’仅能作为有‘修行者’参与的佐证，不能给出更详细的目标。
武夫出身的二叔嫌疑就减轻了，虽说不排除他与人合谋。
线索二的爆炸是一个不合理的疑点，高段位的修行者战斗，引发爆炸很正常。但这起税银失踪案中，不存在武力拼斗，因此，爆炸的出现不合理。
“除非是不得不爆炸！”许七安喃喃道。
“各大修炼体系里，有什么职业是需要靠爆炸来达成目的？”
许七安想了片刻，没得出头绪，随后惊觉自己和京兆府犯了同样的错误。
京兆府的思路一开始就出了问题，根据案件中最明显的线索，判断凶手是妖物，然后就在这条路上狂奔，一去不复返。
这并没有错，问题出在，这个判断过于草率。
许七安虽然融合了记忆，但仍然以现代人的思维为主导，以前世的经验为主，他更喜欢在卷宗上抽丝剥茧，去咀嚼那些不易察觉的细节，然后再下定论。
“这个路我暂时想不通，那就换个思路，从其他地方突破。我先排除是妖物作乱，假设这是一场精心策划的，人为事件。”
“那么，他必然会在案件中留下破绽。”

“洛卡尔物质交换定律告诉我们，但凡实施犯罪，就必定会在现场留下直接或间接的痕迹....
形形色色的痕迹可以分为两大类，具体记不太清楚，应该是手脚印、指纹、车马痕迹、工具器械痕迹等。”
“破绽不在最显眼的两个线索里，而在这些形形色色的痕迹上.....”
根据卷宗描述，许七安在脑海里复盘着二叔押运税银的过程。
肾上腺素疯狂分泌，脑细胞高度活跃。如果信息素可以拟态的话，它们就像池中的锦鲤，疯狂争食，水面沸腾。
一遍遍的复盘，一遍遍的推敲，
卷宗上的各种信息和线索汇聚，他的大脑就像高速运行的CPU。
随着各种信息的拼凑，案件越来越清晰。
不知不觉，许七安感觉自己进入了某种状态，他的灵魂轻飘飘的飞了起来，突破了肉体凡胎，突破了建筑物，来到京都上空。
时光仿佛倒流，东边微熹，太阳即将升起，许平志率领一群披坚执锐的甲士，护送税银前往户部。
此时，是卯时二刻......行至广南街，忽然一阵妖风刮来，马匹受惊，冲入河中。
河面爆炸，浊浪排空。
这一声爆炸，仿佛也响在许七安的心里，他条件反射般的蹬腿，清醒过来。
眼神里透着疲惫，却是满脸振奋和狂喜。
“我知道了，我知道了，哈哈哈，我解开谜题了！！”
许七安狂笑着，用力捶打栅栏：“来人啊来人啊，快来人啊。”
负责值守的狱卒被惊动了，拎着一条火棍，喝骂道：“吵吵嚷嚷，嫌命长是吧。”
用力敲打栅栏吓唬许七安。
许七安后退一步，松开握住栅栏的手，免得被敲断指头，他沉声道：“我要见府尹。”
“一个阶下囚，见府尹....也不撒撒泡尿照照自己。”狱卒气笑了，把火棍伸入栅栏，去捅许七安。

许七安又后退躲过。
“你还敢躲？”狱卒摸起腰上的钥匙，狞笑道：“老子今儿打折了你的腿。”
“我有税银被劫案的重要线索，我要见府尹，耽误了案情，你负责。”许七安盯着他。
狱卒脸色一僵。
......
内堂，吃完肉包的少女继续啃甘蔗，时而从鹿皮小包里摸出几颗蜜饯，配着吃。
一边愁云惨淡，一边没心没肺。
“陛下责令我们五天内破案，这是因为时间拖的太久，税银很可能再也追不回来。”陈府尹在堂内来回踱步，他坐不住了：
“但时间如此紧迫，我等束手无策啊。”破案是需要时间的。
府尹大人‘啪’一击掌，沉声道：“我亲自去求魏公，把卷宗给我。”
李玉春犹豫一下：“我与你一同去。”
黄裙少女瞥了他一眼，嫣然道：“这还行，有咱们大奉的这位大国手出马，你俩就不用被陛下问责。”
“但是，在魏公心里减分，可比被陛下问责要严重多了。”她笑起来，露出两颗莹白的小虎牙。
中年男人脸一沉。
一名穿皂衣的衙门低头，疾步进来，躬身道：“府尹大人，狱卒禀报，许平志侄儿许七安，刚刚说有关于税银被劫案的重要线索，想面见大人。”
三人目光同时一凝。
许七安....没记错的话，这只是个与案情无关的边缘人物，经过最初的审问、拷打之后，便被认定是与案情无关的闲杂人等。
陈府尹沉吟一下，道：“把人提过来。”
俄顷，穿着囚服，身上有道道干涸血痕的许七安被衙役带上来，行走间，手铐脚镣哗啦啦作响。
PS：作为一个十八岁的，第一本书的新人，心情忐忑。

今天没了，就三章。
content_en:
This question, no one can answer.
Li Yuchun asked: "What is the reason why the monster robbed the tax money?"
Chen Fuyin pondered for a while: "Monsters never care about their intentions when doing things. They do whatever they want. If you find out the reasons, you are just asking for trouble."
The girl in the yellow dress had a different opinion: "Isn't human flesh more delicious... Well, wait a moment, I'll finish the buns first."
She finished the two big meat buns with a slurp, and her face turned into a steamed bun. She swallowed hard, took a sip of tea, and then continued the topic. She could talk freely about human flesh:
"Monsters do things without scruples, and money may not be as attractive to them as a living person. Even if they want money, stealing or robbing is safer than taking tax money directly."
In Dafeng Kyoto, the risk of stealing tax money on the street is too high.
Chen Fuyin nodded: "It makes sense, I don't rule out that he was instigated by others."
Li Yuchun narrowed his eyes: "Then who would instruct monsters to steal tax money? What is the reason? Why does it have to be this batch of tax money, and it has to be 150,000 taels."
"We can think of it this way. The mastermind behind the scenes needs a huge sum of money, but he can't make too much noise... To be precise, he can't amass money unscrupulously." Chen Fuyin's heart moved.
"So you're focusing on tax money?" The girl in the yellow dress pursed her brightly colored lips.
"The tax bank escort route is random and is temporarily decided by Xu Pingzhi of the Hundred Guards, but the monster can ambush in the river in advance... There is a high possibility of an insider in the escort team." Li Yuchun said and glanced at Chen Fuyin:
"Go to Yunlu Academy and find a Confucian master to inquire about your heart?"
The girl in the yellow skirt glanced sideways at him: "Are you looking down on our Si Tianjian's Qi-gazing technique? I've already told you that the soldiers present to escort the tax bank were completely unaware of it."
The train of thought was stuck again, and the three of them were silent for a while.
The air suddenly became quiet.
Li Yuchun lowered his head and looked at the file carefully, and Chen Fuyin sighed. The girl in the yellow skirt fiddled with the feng shui plate on her waist, thinking that she would leave Jingzhao Mansion before sunset and go into the palace to have a meal with the eldest princess.
The craftsmanship of the palace cooks is first-rate in the world!
Compared with them, the girl named Caiwei in a yellow dress acts more as a guest, assisting in handling cases.
She has no official position. Although she is one of the persons in charge of the case, she does not need to bear much responsibility.
Chen Fuyin's eyes moved slightly and he said tentatively: "The case is progressing slowly at the moment, and time is of the essence. It's really worrying. Mr. Li, why don't you ask Mr. Wei?"
The middle-aged man glanced sideways at him and snorted coldly: "You civil servants have a capital inspector, and we also have a watchman. To be honest, this is the assessment given to me by Duke Wei."
Chen Fuyin smiled bitterly and said: "If this case cannot be solved, I am afraid that the position under my butt will not be saved. The government and the public are watching us."
The two looked at each other in silence, the atmosphere solemn.
...
"If it's a monster causing trouble, then there's nothing I can do!" Xu Qian's face turned pale, feeling the deep malice of God.
There are monsters in this world. Monsters have existed since ancient times, hunting and devouring each other with humans.
In the Hundred Thousand Mountains of southern Xinjiang, there is a Kingdom of Ten Thousand Demons, which is the largest settlement of the demon clan.
Five hundred years ago, under the leadership of Buddhism, the Western countries declared war on the demon kingdom in the southern border. They fought for a long time and finally wiped out the demon kingdom.
The history books named this battle ‘Jiazi Dangyao’.
Since then, the fate of the demon clan has been damaged and it has gradually declined. Since then, Buddhism has soared into the sky, and Buddhism has flourished.
Using the knowledge of Xu Qi'an's later generations to understand, humans won the battle for the top of the food chain.
If the tax money is the work of a monster, then he can only save himself and the Xu family by recovering the money.
As an unyielding silver at the peak of refining, Xu Qian felt that he could not make a comeback.
In the autumn season, the weather was damp and cold, and Xu Qi'an broke out in a cold sweat.
He is afraid!
Integrated with the memory of the original owner, I knowIt is impossible for him to escape from prison, and he knows that in this society where the imperial power is supreme, human rights are too weak.
Life and death are all determined by the thoughts of others.
I used to fantasize about going back to ancient times and copying poems to show off, which felt very satisfying, but reality slapped him hard.
If you travel through time, you will be severely beaten by society.
"No, this is just a guess. This is just a guess from the Jingzhao Mansion Yamen. I can't be affected by their guesses. I will do it myself and analyze it myself... I can still rescue, I can still rescue..."
His strong desire to survive quickly calmed him down, and his logic became rigorous and clear again.
"Why do monsters steal tax money? Isn't human flesh delicious... Even if you are short of money, there is no need to keep an eye on the tax money... I heard from books that all the monster girls in the monster clan are charming and graceful... I wonder if there are any cat ladies or bitches..."
"Pah!" Xu Qian slapped himself, "Re-reason!"
The most important thing in reasoning is to do subtraction, list the clues one by one, and sort them out.
Otherwise, it’s just a ball of yarn, and it will only become more confusing the more you think about it.
The two most obvious clues in the tax bank case:
One: Demonic wind!
Two: The tax silver exploded after falling into the river!
In addition to martial arts, all major cultivation systems have the ability to blow away demonic winds. Therefore, 'Clue 1' can only be used as evidence that a 'practitioner' is involved, and cannot give more detailed goals.
The suspicion of the second uncle, who was born as a martial artist, has been reduced, although it is not ruled out that he is colluding with others.
The explosion in clue two is an unreasonable doubt. It is normal for high-level practitioners to fight and cause explosions. However, there was no armed struggle in the case of the missing tax bank, so the explosion was unreasonable.
"Unless it has to explode!" Xu Qian muttered.
"Among the major cultivation systems, are there any professions that rely on explosions to achieve their goals?"
Xu Qian thought for a moment, but couldn't figure it out. Then he was shocked to realize that he and Jingzhao Mansion had made the same mistake.
There was a problem with Jingzhaofu's thinking from the beginning. Based on the most obvious clues in the case, he judged that the murderer was a monster, and then ran wildly on this road, never to return.
There is nothing wrong with this. The problem is that this judgment is too hasty.
Although Xu Qi'an has integrated memory, he is still dominated by modern thinking and the experience of past lives. He prefers to peel off the cocoons in the files to chew on the details that are not easy to detect, and then make a conclusion.
"I can't figure out this way for the moment, so I'll change my mind and break through from other places. I'll first rule out the possibility of monsters causing trouble and assume that this is a carefully planned, man-made incident."
"Then he will definitely leave holes in the case."
"Locard's Law of Material Exchange tells us that whenever a crime is committed, it will leave direct or indirect traces at the scene...
The various traces can be divided into two categories. I can’t remember the details clearly, but they should be hand and foot prints, fingerprints, traces of carriages and horses, traces of tools and equipment, etc. "
"The flaws are not in the two most conspicuous clues, but in these various traces..."
According to the description in the file, Xu Qian replayed in his mind the process of his second uncle escorting the tax money.
Adrenaline is secreted crazily and brain cells are highly active. If pheromones could imitate, they would be like koi fish in a pond, frantically competing for food and the water boiling.
Reviewing over and over again, deliberating over and over again,
All kinds of information and clues in the dossier were gathered together, and his brain was like a high-speed CPU.
As information is pieced together, the case becomes clearer and clearer.
Unknowingly, Xu Qi'an felt that he had entered a certain state. His soul flew up lightly, breaking through the mortal body, breaking through the building, and came to the sky above Kyoto.
Time seems to be going back. It's dim in the east and the sun is about to rise. Xu Pingzhi leads a group of hard-wearing soldiers to escort the tax bank to the household department.
At this time, it was the second quarter of Mao... When I walked to Guangnan Street, there was a sudden burst ofThe evil wind blew, and the horses were frightened and rushed into the river.
The river exploded and the turbid waves emptied.
This explosion seemed to ring in Xu Qian's heart, and he kicked his legs reflexively to wake up.
There was fatigue in his eyes, but his face was full of excitement and ecstasy.
"I know, I know, hahaha, I solved the puzzle!!"
Xu Qian laughed wildly and beat the fence hard: "Someone is coming, someone is coming, someone is coming quickly."
The jailer on duty was alerted, carrying a fire stick and yelling: "You are making a lot of noise, you are not going to live long, right?"
He banged the fence hard to scare Xu Qian.
Xu Qian took a step back and loosened his grip on the fence to avoid having his fingers broken off. He said in a deep voice, "I want to see Fu Yin."
"A prisoner of one rank, even when he meets the governor, he doesn't even urinate and look after himself." The jailer laughed angrily, put the poker into the fence, and stabbed Xu Qian.
Xu Qian retreated again to avoid it.
"You still dare to hide?" The jailer touched the key on his waist and said with a sinister smile: "I've broken your leg today."
"I have important clues about the robbery of the tax bank. I want to see the governor. If I delay the case, you are responsible." Xu Qian stared at him.
The jailer's face stiffened.
...
In the inner hall, the girl who finished eating the meat buns continued to chew sugar cane, and occasionally took out a few candied fruits from the deerskin packet to eat with them.
One side is gloomy and the other side is heartless.
"Your Majesty ordered us to solve the case within five days. This is because the time delay is too long, and the tax money may never be recovered." Chen Fuyin paced back and forth in the hall. He couldn't sit still:
"But time is so tight and we are helpless." Solving crimes takes time.
Mr. Fu Yin gave a high-five and said in a deep voice: "I will personally go and ask Mr. Wei to give me the file."
Li Yuchun hesitated: "I'll go with you."
The girl in the yellow skirt glanced at him and said sweetly: "That's not bad. With our great master from Dafeng taking action, you two don't have to be held accountable by His Majesty."
"However, losing points in Wei Gong's mind is much more serious than being held accountable by His Majesty." She smiled, revealing two small white tiger teeth.
The middle-aged man's face sank.
A yamen man in soap clothes lowered his head, walked in quickly, and bowed: "Master Fu Yin, the jailer reported that Xu Pingzhi's nephew Xu Qian just said that he has important clues about the robbery of the tax bank and wants to meet with you."
The three of them stared at each other at the same time.
Xu Qian... If I remember correctly, he was just a marginal figure who had nothing to do with the case. After the initial interrogation and torture, he was identified as an idler who had nothing to do with the case.
Chen Fuyin pondered for a moment and said: "Bring the person over."
A few moments later, Xu Qian, who was wearing prison uniform and with traces of dried blood on his body, was brought up by the yamen. As he walked, his handcuffs and shackles clattered.
PS: As an eighteen-year-old and a newcomer to the first book, I felt uneasy.
No more today, just three chapters.
